user_story:
As a store owner,
I want the checkout process to prevent customers from completing an order with a shipping method that has become unavailable,
So that customers cannot place orders using shipping methods that are no longer valid or offered.

Acceptance Criteria:
- When a customer has selected a shipping method and payment method during checkout, but that shipping method is subsequently disabled entirely, the system should block order confirmation and inform the customer that the chosen shipping method is not available.
- When a customer has selected a shipping method and payment method during checkout, but that shipping method is subsequently disabled specifically for the channel/country associated with their order, the system should block order confirmation and inform the customer that the chosen shipping method is not available.
- In both cases, the customer should not be able to successfully confirm and place the order while the selected shipping method remains disabled.

As a Loan Officer,
I want the system to correctly calculate and manage progressive loan repayment schedules, disbursements, chargebacks, and pay-offs—including edge cases with very small disbursement amounts and various future installment allocation strategies (NEXT_INSTALLMENT, LAST_INSTALLMENT)—under the Advanced Payment Allocation strategy,
So that loan balances, repayment schedules, and transaction records remain accurate and consistent, and improper actions (such as undoing a transaction linked to a chargeback) are correctly blocked with clear error messages.

Acceptance Criteria:
- When a progressive loan is created with a very small total disbursement amount (e.g., less than 1 unit) and disbursed partially, the repayment schedule and loan transactions must accurately reflect the disbursed amount, and a full pay-off must close the loan with zero outstanding balance and all installment obligations met, regardless of whether the loan has 1 or multiple repayment periods.
- When a repayment transaction has a linked chargeback, attempting to undo that repayment transaction must be rejected with a 403 error and the message "update not allowed as loan transaction is linked to other transactions"; the loan must still be payable off and closed with zero outstanding balance afterward.
- When the loan product's future installment allocation rule is set to NEXT_INSTALLMENT for vertical progressive loan schedules, a full prepayment made before the term ends must correctly reallocate paid amounts across all remaining installments (marking them as paid in advance where applicable), generate the appropriate accrual transaction, and close the loan with zero outstanding balance.
- When the loan product's future installment allocation rule is set to LAST_INSTALLMENT for vertical progressive loan schedules, the system must calculate and apply the repayment schedule, disbursement, and prepayment behavior consistently with the defined allocation rule, ensuring accurate totals for principal, interest, fees, penalties, due, paid, in-advance, late, and outstanding amounts across all periods.

As a loan officer,
I want to terminate a progressive loan contract with automatic interest recalculation at any point in its lifecycle,
So that I can accurately close out loans early while ensuring the outstanding balance, interest, and repayment schedule are correctly recalculated as of the termination date.

Acceptance Criteria:
- When a contract termination is performed on an installment due date, the system recalculates the repayment schedule to show only the periods up to and including the termination date, with interest accrued and due amounts correctly adjusted, and generates matching Accrual and Contract Termination transactions.
- When a contract termination is performed before an installment date (e.g., mid-period), the system prorates the interest calculation up to the termination date, updates the schedule and total row accordingly, and records the correct Accrual and Contract Termination transactions with zero remaining outstanding balance.
- When a contract termination is performed in the middle of an installment period, the system recalculates the number of days, interest due, and outstanding balance up to that exact date, ensuring the transactions tab reflects accurate Accrual and Contract Termination entries.
- When a contract termination is performed after the loan's maturity date (with prior repayments already made and the "is-principal-compounding-disabled-for-overdue-loans" configuration enabled), the system correctly recalculates the remaining schedule, interest, and balances based on payments already applied.
- After any successful contract termination and subsequent loan pay-off on the same date, the loan must be closed with a zero outstanding balance, and all installments must show that their obligations have been fully met.

user_story:
As a new user,
I want to register an account and be guided through an initial setup wizard on the getting started page,
So that I can safely personalize my profile, optionally follow tags, and publish my first status message before entering the main stream.

Acceptance Criteria:
- After completing registration, the user is redirected to the getting started page displaying the setup wizard, with the publisher expanded and ready for input.
- Input fields such as the first name must be sanitized against script injection, and the flash message must safely echo the entered name without executing scripts.
- The user can either skip the setup wizard (via a confirmation prompt) or cancel it (via a rejection prompt), with appropriate flash messages and page redirection in each case.
- If the user proceeds without adding tags, the default first post reads "Hey everyone, I’m #newhere." while providing tags appends them, e.g., "Hey everyone, I’m #newhere. I’m interested in #rockstar."
- The first status message defaults to "Public" visibility, and closing popovers or the publisher clears the getting started welcome content.
- Attempting registration with invalid or malformed data (username, email, password) must trigger client-side validation errors and prevent account creation.
- Attempting to register with an already existing username/email must show a failure flash message, while subsequent successful sign-in attempts must not display that failure message.

@javascript
  Feature: registering an account and completing the getting started wizard

  Background:
    Given following users exist:
      | username   |
      | bob        |

  Scenario: successful registration redirects to the getting started page with publisher expanded
    When I sign up with username "newuser", email "newuser@example.com" and password "ValidPass123"

    And the publisher should be expanded

    And I submit the getting started form

    And no javascript alert should have been triggered

  Scenario: skip the setup wizard with confirmation
    When I sign up with username "newuser", email "newuser@example.com" and password "ValidPass123"
    And I confirm the alert after I click to skip the getting started wizard
    Then I should see a flash message containing "You have skipped the getting started wizard"
    And I should be on the stream page

  Scenario: cancel skipping the setup wizard
    When I sign up with username "newuser", email "newuser@example.com" and password "ValidPass123"
    And I dismiss the alert after I click to skip the getting started wizard
    Then I should be on the getting started page
    And I should not see a flash message containing "You have skipped the getting started wizard"

  Scenario: default first status message without tags

    And the status message visibility should be "Public"

  Scenario: first status message with additional tags
    When I sign up with username "newuser", email "newuser@example.com" and password "ValidPass123"
    And I add the tag "rockstar" to my first status message
    And I click to publish my first status message
    Then I should see a status message with text "Hey everyone, I’m #newhere. I’m interested in #rockstar."
    And the status message visibility should be "Public"

  Scenario: closing the getting started publisher clears the welcome content
    When I sign up with username "newuser", email "newuser@example.com" and password "ValidPass123"
    And I click to close the getting started publisher
    Then I should not see the getting started welcome content

  Scenario: closing a getting started popover clears the welcome content
    When I sign up with username "newuser", email "newuser@example.com" and password "ValidPass123"
    And I click to close the getting started popover
    Then I should not see the getting started welcome content

  Scenario: registration fails with an invalid username
    When I sign up with username "!!invalid!!", email "newuser@example.com" and password "ValidPass123"

    And no account should have been created

    And I sign in as "bob@bob.bob"
    Then I should be on the stream page
    And I should not see a flash message containing "Username has already been taken"

user_story:
As a mobile user,
I want to view my activity stream showing posts I've created and liked,
So that I can quickly track my own contributions and interactions on the platform.

Acceptance Criteria:
- When a user has not created or liked any posts, the "My activity" page should display no posts in the stream.
- When a user likes a post, that post should appear within the user's "My activity" stream.
- When a user creates a post, that post should appear within the user's own "My activity" stream.

      When I sign in as "alice@alice.alice"

user_story:
As a new user who has received an invitation from an existing member,
I want to accept the invitation and complete my account registration,
So that I can join the platform and immediately connect with the person who invited me.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an invitation email has been sent by an existing user (e.g., "alice@alice.alice"), the invited user can access their acceptance form page.
- Upon filling in the new user form with the required information and pressing "Create account", the user should see a "welcome to diaspora" confirmation message.
- After account creation, the new user should be able to friend/connect with the person who sent the invitation.
- The new user should be able to select an aspect (e.g., "Family") from the "user_aspects" dropdown within the "#hello-there" section.
- Once an aspect is selected, the aspect dropdown within "#hello-there" should correctly display the chosen label (e.g., "Family").

@javascript
  Feature: accepting an invitation

    When I go to the invitation acceptance page for "bob@bob.bob"
    And I fill in the new user form with valid information
